name: Known Low Hemoglobin / Iron Deficiency
nutritionConsiderations: Prioritize plant or heme iron sources paired with Vitamin C to support absorption
Maintain at least 1 hour separation between iron-rich meals and calcium supplements, tea, or coffee
Incorporate green leafy vegetables, lentils, and sprouted pulses
activityConsiderations: Begin physical activity at a comfortable pace with gentle progression
Take movement breaks if experiencing fatigue; listen to your body energy levels
sleepConsiderations: Aim for 7.5 - 8 hours of restorative sleep to assist cellular recovery
hydrationConsiderations: Maintain regular water intake throughout the day (2.5 - 3 Liters)

name: Type 2 Diabetes / Pre-diabetes
nutritionConsiderations: Focus on complex low-glycemic index (GI) carbohydrates with high dietary fiber
Pair carbohydrates with protein and healthy fats to buffer postprandial glucose curves
Distribute meals evenly across the day and avoid skipping scheduled meals
activityConsiderations: 10-15 minute post-meal walking helps support natural glucose clearance
Moderate aerobic exercise 4-5 days a week is recommended
sleepConsiderations: Consistent bedtime is associated with improved insulin sensitivity
hydrationConsiderations: Adequate hydration supports kidney filtration of excess glucose
sources: American Diabetes Association Standards of Care

name: High Blood Pressure / Hypertension
nutritionConsiderations: Adhere to DASH-style dietary principles emphasizing potassium, magnesium, and calcium
Keep sodium intake moderate (prefer under 2,000mg/day from foods)
Flavor dishes with garlic, herbs, and lemon instead of excessive salt
activityConsiderations: Rhythmic aerobic activities like brisk walking, cycling, or swimming
Avoid heavy breath-holding (Valsalva maneuver) during resistance exercises
sleepConsiderations: Prioritize 7-8 hours of uninterrupted sleep; poor sleep elevates sympathetic blood pressure tone
hydrationConsiderations: Balanced daily fluid intake without rapid bolus volumes

name: GERD / Acid Reflux / Gastritis
nutritionConsiderations: Smaller, more frequent meals reduce gastric distension and lower esophageal sphincter pressure
Allow at least 2.5 to 3 hours between finishing dinner and lying down to sleep
Avoid trigger foods such as excessive raw onions, peppermint, and deep-fried foods
activityConsiderations: Avoid vigorous abdominal crunches or inverted yoga poses immediately after eating
sleepConsiderations: Elevate head of bed slightly if nighttime symptoms persist; finish dinner 3 hours prior
hydrationConsiderations: Sip water gently throughout the day rather than drinking large volumes with meals
sources: American College of Gastroenterology GERD Guidelines

name: Known Heart Condition / Complex Cardiovascular Condition
nutritionConsiderations: Heart conditions require strict physician guidance on sodium, fluids, and lifestyle
Our recommendations provide only general conservative guidance; consult your cardiologist
activityConsiderations: Do not engage in unmonitored high-intensity workouts; stick strictly to physician-cleared activity
sleepConsiderations: Consistent restful sleep is vital for cardiac stability
hydrationConsiderations: Fluid intake must be reviewed by your physician if fluid restriction has been prescribed

name: Thyroid-Related Condition (Hypothyroid / Hyperthyroid)
nutritionConsiderations: Take thyroid medication on an empty stomach with plain water at least 45 minutes before breakfast
Maintain adequate selenium, zinc, and tyrosine from diverse whole foods
Cook cruciferous vegetables (cabbage, cauliflower) thoroughly to deactivate goitrogens

limit: raw cruciferous vegetables in large amounts

activityConsiderations: Consistent moderate daily activity supports healthy metabolic rate
sleepConsiderations: Ensure 7-9 hours of consistent sleep as circadian rhythm regulates endocrine function
hydrationConsiderations: Regular water intake supports cellular metabolism

name: Asthma / Reactive Airway Condition
nutritionConsiderations: Eat a rainbow of antioxidant-rich fruits and vegetables to support airway health
Avoid known personal food triggers and foods with artificial sulfites
Sip warm infusions like ginger or chamomile
activityConsiderations: Always perform a 5-10 minute gentle warm-up before any cardio or brisk exercise
Keep your prescribed rescue inhaler accessible during all physical routines
sleepConsiderations: Keep sleeping quarters allergen and dust-free; use hypoallergenic bedding
hydrationConsiderations: Adequate hydration keeps airway mucus thin and easy to clear
